image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a jeweler's loupe resting on a reflective surface. The loupe features a circular brass or copper-colored metal frame holding a convex glass lens. The lens reflects the environment and shows internal optical distortions typical of magnification. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), showing indistinct shapes that suggest other jewelry tools or gems.
